FlatCheckSpec.title: FlatCheckSpec
FlatCheckSpec.description:
A flat check dict as sent by the scenario editor's test button.

Accepts ``{"identifier": "hub_correctness", "override_spec": {"reference": "..."}}``
or ``{"check_id": "<uuid>", "override_spec": {...}}`` and converts to
``InteractionCheckConfig``.

All check-specific parameters (e.g. ``reference``, ``rules``, ``context``) must
be nested inside ``override_spec`` — extra top-level keys are rejected so that
``kind`` and other internal fields cannot be injected.
